text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On my day off, I visited an antique café
with Manhattan Cafe, one of her regular haunts.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
What should I get today...?
—Ah.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: No, I just happened upon a brand of coffee with a rather nostalgic name...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, would you care to try some
as well, Trainer...? I can vouch for the taste...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Thank you...
Then, allow me to place our order...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
What a lovely scent... Listen to the music...
Let go of your thoughts—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A cozy space, the aroma of brewing coffee. It brings about a deeply relaxing mood...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—While doing so,
a mysterious melody drifted in from somewhere.
Opening my eyes...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my...
Have you wandered in and gotten lost as well...?"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I don't know... I drank some coffee,
closed my eyes, and when I opened them, I was here...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I walked around searching for an exit for a while, but
there didn't seem to be anything like that.
In that case—
choice_data_list: Since we're here, shall we stay and play for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking the same thing...
Since we came all the way to an amusement park and all...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: So, where should we go...?
choice_data_list: Let's go into the haunted house.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
A haunted house within an illusion, is it...?
Fufu, it seems we should proceed with caution...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
What an elaborately crafted illusion...
It has quite the atmosphere—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Isn't this place a bit *too* atmospheric...?
Just as I felt a shiver run down my spine—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Ah—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, the ground beneath me felt weightless,
and it felt like I was falling into darkness...!
In a panic, I reached my hand upward—!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: "It's okay, I've got you...! This way...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With a firm tug, I finally managed to steady my footing.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
The footing seems unstable here...
Please follow close behind me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—Tap, tap!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With every step Manhattan Cafe took,
the ground beneath her lit up like a starry night sky.
I followed closely in her footsteps, as if chasing after it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Truly a dreamlike spectacle—
perhaps because of the frightening ordeal, every single light
felt all the more dazzlingly bright.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Feeling fully contented, I grew a bit drowsy...
and when I opened my eyes once more—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
How wonderful...
I wonder what kind of view awaits us at the top...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We moved on and boarded an empty Ferris wheel.
Swaying gently as we finally seemed to reach
the very top—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (――BANG!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A loud noise echoed out!
I don't know what happened, but I have to
protect Manhattan Cafe no matter what...!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer, it's alright.
Please lift your head..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Fireworks...
They're so colorful and pretty...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Yes... That must have been the sound of fireworks going off...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching the massive fireworks blossom in the sky,
I felt a sense of relief, as if the tension had drained away—but then—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much... for protecting me earlier...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Shielding me without hesitation like that... made me really happy...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing Manhattan Cafe say that
made me feel like all my efforts were rewarded.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Feeling fully contented, I grew a bit drowsy...
and when I opened my eyes once more—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Welcome back.
I've just returned as well..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It is likely a phantom reached through
a shared resonance of taste...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"And the origin of that lies in my memories...
You see, this coffee...
is one my parents used to drink often."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if that joyful feeling
from my childhood has been rekindled...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
............
...I'm glad to hear that.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
To see the same phantom as someone else...
is extremely... extremely rare, after all...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe didn't seem to notice—
but on the way home, her shadow swayed as if dancing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sharing the same experience with someone
might have actually made me quite happy.
